message:
docs(release): the empty key blocks the update path, not the installer

The note read as though the candidate could not be installed at all. Only
the in-app update path is blocked: the trusted key is what verifies an
update manifest, and it has nothing to do with running the installer.
GNLinkSetup-0.2.105.exe installs by hand exactly as it should, and the APK
carries the deployed signer with versionCode 12 over 11, so it upgrades an
existing install in place.

The distinction is the one that decides whether anybody can field-test this
at all, so it should not have been left to be inferred.
